news.titleEn: China's Xi to Visit the US From September 23-25
news.conclusionEn: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in Washington on September 23 for a three-day state visit, with the main summit with President Trump set for September 24.
news.conclusionZh: 习近平抵达华盛顿，24日与特朗普举行峰会
news.whyEn: The meeting could shape trade tariffs, rare-earth export controls, Taiwan tensions and global AI policy, all of which move markets worldwide.
news.whyZh: 会谈将影响关税、稀土出口管制、台海局势及全球AI政策走向
news.detailEn: Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan will land at Joint Base Andrews on September 23, where Trump plans to personally greet them in an unusual protocol gesture. Formal state visit events continue September 24-25, including a Rose Garden ceremony, the main bilateral summit, and a state dinner attended by tech executives. Agenda items include easing tariffs under the fragile trade truce reached at last year's Busan summit, rare-earth export controls set to expire in November, a stalled Taiwan arms package, and rival approaches to AI regulation. Analysts expect incremental progress on trade but no breakthroughs on Taiwan or tech.
news.detailZh: 习近平将携夫人彭丽媛于9月23日抵达安德鲁斯联合基地，特朗普将罕见地亲自到机场迎接。9月24日至25日为正式国事访问活动，包括玫瑰园欢迎仪式、主要双边峰会以及有科技高管出席的国宴。议题包括去年釜山峰会达成的脆弱贸易休战如何巩固、11月即将到期的稀土出口管制、搁置中的对台军售，以及中美在AI监管上的分歧。分析人士预计贸易问题会有渐进进展，但台湾和科技议题难有突破。

news.titleEn: Trump tells U.N. he could 'annihilate' Iran but expects a deal after the midterm elections
news.conclusionEn: In his UN General Assembly address, Trump said he must decide whether to strike a deal with Iran or "annihilate" it, predicting an agreement only after November's US midterms.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普联大演讲：或"消灭"伊朗，或等中期选举后达成协议
news.whyEn: The remarks keep the seven-month Iran war's endgame uncertain, injecting fresh volatility risk into oil markets and Gulf security.
news.whyZh: 伊朗战局走向未定，为油价和海湾地区安全带来新的不确定性
news.detailEn: Trump told world leaders he faces a stark choice on Iran: negotiate a deal that lets the country "rebuild and create a far greater nation," or "annihilate the Islamic Republic." He said he expects a deal only after November's midterm elections, arguing it "doesn't make sense" for Iran to refuse indefinitely. On AI, Trump rejected any global effort to restrict development, proposing the field be renamed "superintelligence" and pledging to "encourage it, not rein it in." Delegates from Cuba and Iran walked out at points during the speech.
news.detailZh: 特朗普对各国领导人表示，他在伊朗问题上面临抉择：要么达成协议让伊朗「重建并变得更强大」，要么「消灭伊斯兰共和国」。他预计协议只会在11月中期选举后达成，称伊朗没道理无限期拒绝谈判。在AI议题上，特朗普拒绝任何全球性监管努力，提议将该领域改称为「超级智能」，并承诺「鼓励而非约束」其发展。演讲过程中，古巴和伊朗代表团一度退场。

news.titleEn: US and Iranian negotiators hold talks at UN that Trump says 'went very well'
news.conclusionEn: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held three hours of indirect talks with an Iranian delegation at the UN on September 22, which Trump called a success.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊代表在联大举行三小时会谈，特朗普称"进展很好"
news.whyEn: It's the most substantive US-Iran contact since the war began, raising hopes of de-escalation that could ease oil markets and Gulf tensions.
news.whyZh: 是伊朗战争爆发以来美伊最实质性接触，或缓解油价与海湾紧张
news.detailEn: Trump said his envoys met Iranian officials for three hours on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly and that another meeting is planned "in the very near future," though he noted the Iranian representatives were "not the highest level." Witkoff later clarified the talks were indirect, with mediators shuttling between the two delegations rather than face-to-face negotiation. Iran's foreign minister reportedly conveyed conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, including lifting the naval blockade and releasing frozen Iranian assets. Trump again warned Iran faces "potential greatness, or obliteration" depending on the outcome.
news.detailZh: 特朗普表示，其特使与伊朗官员在联大边会上举行了三小时会谈，并计划「近期内」再次会面，但他也提到伊朗代表「级别不是最高」。威特科夫随后澄清，此次会谈为间接接触，由中间人在双方之间穿梭传话，而非直接面对面谈判。据报道，伊朗外长向美方转达了重开霍尔木兹海峡的条件，包括解除海军封锁、释放被冻结的伊朗资产。特朗普再次警告，伊朗面临的结果要么是「巨大机遇」，要么是「彻底毁灭」。

news.titleEn: AMD hits $1 trillion market cap for the first time as stock rides 5-day rally
news.conclusionEn: AMD shares surged about 10% on September 21 to a record high near $615, pushing its market cap above $1 trillion for the first time.
news.conclusionZh: AMD股价飙升近10%，市值首次突破1万亿美元
news.whyEn: It signals investors' continued conviction in the AI infrastructure boom and directly affects portfolios and index funds tracking major tech stocks.
news.whyZh: 反映市场对AI基建热潮的信心，影响追踪科技股的基金与养老金
news.detailEn: AMD became the fourth US chipmaker to cross $1 trillion in market value, joining Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron, as its stock extended a five-day winning streak to roughly 25% and is up more than 180% for the year. The rally was part of a broader chip-sector surge that also lifted Intel and Arm Holdings by around 10-12%, fueled partly by enthusiasm over Meta's new Muse AI agent. The Nasdaq Composite closed at a record high the same day, with the S&P 500 within 0.4% of its own record, as falling oil prices and optimism ahead of the Trump-Xi summit boosted risk appetite.
news.detailZh: AMD成为继英伟达、博通、美光之后第四家市值突破1万亿美元的美国芯片公司，股价延续五连涨、涨幅约25%，年内累计涨幅超180%。此轮上涨属于芯片板块整体走强的一部分，英特尔和Arm股价也上涨约10%至12%，部分受到Meta新推出的Muse AI助手带动。同日纳斯达克综合指数创收盘历史新高，标普500距历史高点仅差0.4%，油价回落及市场对中美峰会的乐观情绪提振了风险偏好。

news.titleEn: Alibaba shares jump as new AI chip, data center buildout plans unveiled
news.conclusionEn: Alibaba unveiled its Zhenwu V900 chip, claimed to be China's most powerful AI chip, alongside plans to expand global data center capacity to over 20 gigawatts by 2032.
news.conclusionZh: 阿里发布新一代AI芯片"玄武V900"及数据中心扩张计划
news.whyEn: It underscores China's push for AI chip self-sufficiency amid US export controls, a key factor in the broader US-China tech rivalry.
news.whyZh: 显示中国在美国出口管制下加速AI芯片自主，牵动中美科技博弈
news.detailEn: Alibaba said the Zhenwu V900 delivers three times the performance of its predecessor and is slated for mass production in the first quarter of 2027. The company also confirmed its next-generation Qwen 4 model is in training, with plans for Qwen 4.5 and Qwen 5 versions and an eventual goal of training a model with 5 to 10 trillion parameters. Alibaba shares rose about 3% in Hong Kong trading on the news. The announcement comes as Chinese tech firms race to reduce reliance on Nvidia chips amid ongoing US export restrictions.
news.detailZh: 阿里表示，玄武V900芯片性能是上一代产品的三倍，计划2027年第一季度量产。公司同时确认新一代通义千问Qwen 4模型正在训练中，后续还将推出Qwen 4.5和Qwen 5，目标是最终训练出参数规模达5万亿至10万亿的模型。消息公布后，阿里巴巴港股股价上涨约3%。此次发布正值中国科技企业在美国出口管制下加速摆脱对英伟达芯片依赖之际。

news.titleEn: Current price of oil as of September 22, 2026
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude fell to $99.27 a barrel on September 22, down more than 2% from the previous day, extending a multi-day decline.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油跌至99.27美元，单日跌幅超2%
news.whyEn: Falling oil eases inflation pressure on consumers and central banks, though prices remain nearly 49% higher than a year ago due to the Iran war.
news.whyZh: 油价回落缓解通胀压力，但仍比去年同期高近49%，因伊朗战争推高溢价
news.detailEn: Brent crude dropped from $101.61 to $99.27 a barrel, a 2.3% decline, as investors weighed signs of possible US-Iran de-escalation following talks at the UN General Assembly. Despite the pullback, oil remains up nearly 49% year-over-year, reflecting the risk premium built up during the seven-month Iran war and related Middle East supply disruptions, including attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline. Analysts caution that prices could reverse quickly if diplomatic efforts falter or the conflict escalates further.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油从101.61美元跌至99.27美元，单日跌幅2.3%，市场正在消化联大期间美伊会谈释放出的局势缓和迹象。尽管近期回落，油价较去年同期仍高出近49%，反映出七个月伊朗战争及沙特东西输油管道遭袭等中东供应中断带来的风险溢价。分析师提醒，若外交努力受挫或冲突升级，油价可能迅速反弹。

news.titleEn: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill three as Zelenskyy in US for UN summit
news.conclusionEn: Russia launched 212 drones and cruise missiles at Ukrainian industrial and energy sites overnight, killing three, as Zelenskyy pushed for an energy-infrastructure strike moratorium at the UN.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军空袭乌克兰致3死，泽连斯基在联大推动能源设施停火
news.whyEn: It shows the war's toll continues even as diplomacy advances, with implications for European energy security and Western military support.
news.whyZh: 显示战争代价持续，牵动欧洲能源安全及西方对乌军援走向
news.detailEn: Russia's overnight barrage of 212 drones and several cruise and ballistic missiles struck Dnipropetrovsk region industrial sites, including Zelenskyy's hometown of Kryvyi Rih, killing at least three people and cutting power to about 100,000 residents in Chernihiv. Zelenskyy traveled to New York for roughly 20 meetings during the UN General Assembly, including with Trump, and announced a new air-defense "drone deal." French President Macron said France and the US had agreed to pursue a moratorium on strikes targeting energy networks and civilian infrastructure in Ukraine.
news.detailZh: 俄罗斯一夜之间出动212架无人机及多枚巡航导弹和弹道导弹，袭击第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州多处工业设施，包括泽连斯基家乡克里维里赫，造成至少3人死亡，切尔尼戈夫约10万居民断电。泽连斯基赴纽约出席联大期间安排约20场会晤，其中包括与特朗普的会面，并宣布达成新的防空「无人机协议」。法国总统马克龙表示，法美已同意推动就停止打击乌克兰能源网络及民用设施达成停火协议。

businessTips.explanationEn: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative you give up when making a choice. Every decision — whether spending money, time, or resources — has a hidden cost beyond the price tag: what you could have done instead. Smart managers weigh not just the direct cost of an option, but what they're sacrificing by not choosing something else. Ignoring opportunity cost often leads to sticking with a "safe" but suboptimal path simply because its cost isn't visible on a balance sheet.
businessTips.explanationZh: 机会成本是指做出某个选择时，所放弃的次优选项的价值。任何决策——无论是花钱、花时间还是投入资源——除了标价之外，都有一个隐藏成本：本可以用来做别的事情。精明的管理者不仅要看一个选项的直接成本，还要看放弃其他选项所付出的代价。忽视机会成本，往往会让人只因为看不到账面成本，就固守一条「安全」但并非最优的路径。
businessTips.exampleEn: A founder spends $50,000 and six months building an in-house app instead of using a $500/month off-the-shelf tool. The opportunity cost isn't just the $50,000 — it's the six months of product development the team gave up while building instead of selling. A retailer keeping cash in a 2% savings account also pays an opportunity cost if reinvesting in inventory could have generated a 20% return.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位创业者花费5万美元、六个月时间自建内部应用，而不是使用每月500美元的现成工具。机会成本不只是这5万美元，还包括团队本可以用来做产品迭代和拓展市场的六个月时间。一家零售商把现金存在收益2%的储蓄账户里，如果这笔钱本可以投入库存获得20%回报，那么这也是一种机会成本。

businessTips.explanationEn: An MVP is the simplest version of a product that lets you test a core idea with real customers before investing heavily in building it out. Rather than spending months perfecting every feature, founders release a bare-bones version to learn what users actually want and whether they'll pay for it. This reduces wasted effort and lets you pivot quickly based on real feedback instead of assumptions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是产品最简化的版本，让你能在投入大量资源前，先用真实客户验证核心想法是否成立。创业者不必花几个月打磨每一个功能，而是先推出一个基础版本，了解用户真正想要什么、是否愿意付费。这样可以减少无谓的投入，并能根据真实反馈而非主观假设快速调整方向。
businessTips.exampleEn: A side-hustler wanting to sell a meal-planning app could first launch a simple spreadsheet template or a landing page collecting email sign-ups, instead of building a full app immediately. If enough people sign up or pay for the spreadsheet, that validates demand before writing a single line of app code. Dropbox famously started with just an explainer video to gauge interest before building the product.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位想做副业的人如果打算卖一款膳食规划App，可以先推出一个简单的表格模板或收集邮箱订阅的落地页，而不是立刻开发完整App。如果有足够多人注册或愿意为这个表格付费，就说明需求确实存在，之后再动手写代码也不迟。Dropbox当年就是先做了一段演示视频来验证用户兴趣，之后才开始真正开发产品。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging means investing a fixed amount of money at regular intervals, regardless of the asset's price, rather than trying to time the market with one lump sum. This spreads your purchases across market highs and lows, naturally buying more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high. Over time, it lowers the average cost per share and reduces the emotional stress of guessing the "right" moment to invest.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（Dollar-Cost Averaging）是指按固定金额、固定频率投资，而不去猜测市场高低点、一次性投入全部资金。这样做能把买入时机分散在市场的高点和低点，价格低时自然买入更多份额，价格高时买入更少。长期来看，这能降低平均持有成本，也减少了因猜测「最佳时机」而产生的心理压力。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor puts $500 into an index fund on the first of every month, regardless of whether the market is up or down that day. During a market dip, that $500 buys more shares; during a rally, it buys fewer — smoothing out the average purchase price over the year. This is why many retirement plans, like automatic 401(k) contributions, are structured as recurring investments rather than one-time bets.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者每月1号固定投入500美元到指数基金，无论当天市场涨跌。市场下跌时，这500美元能买到更多份额；市场上涨时买到的份额较少，从而拉平全年的平均购买成本。许多退休金计划（比如401(k)的自动扣款）之所以采用定期定额的方式，而不是一次性押注，正是基于这个原理。
